summary: Validated 'Encaixe rápido' (quick booking) for professional and manager. Backend: 5 passing, 1 skipped (only one active pro in Meu Studio, cannot test cross-pro 403 in this env). Frontend: professional flow (registered client + new client, both outside working hours - Sunday 22:30 UTC and weekday 07:00 UTC) both create confirmed quick appointments, agenda day auto-switches, amber 'Encaixe' badge (data-testid quick-badge) is rendered; qb-pro select is correctly hidden for professionals. Manager sees qb-pro select on /agenda and quick-badge chips on /agendamentos list. All GET /api/clients?scope=all as professional returns minimal {id,name,phone} shape. Non-quick booking outside hours returns 409 'Fora do horário de funcionamento'; client role POST quick=true is denied with 403.
critical_code_review_comments: QuickBooking.jsx builds start from `new Date(day + 'T' + time + ':00').toISOString()` — this uses BROWSER LOCAL time then converts to UTC. This is intentional (user picks local time), but be aware: for test automation, the browser's TZ inside CI may differ from user TZ. In this preview environment the container tz appears to be UTC so `qb-time=22:30` was stored as 22:30Z; a real user in America/Sao_Paulo picking 22:30 would store 01:30Z next day. Working as designed but worth documenting.
server.py _slot_ok — when skip_hours=True the working-hours branch is bypassed but the professional 'active' check still runs; ok.
list_clients scope=all is professional-only; if a manager calls it, the scope param is silently ignored (falls through to the full listing). Not a bug but the behaviour could be documented.
